messages:
auditor-bot: Hi team — SOC2/ISO fieldwork incoming. Auditor requests: RBAC change history for privileged promotions and temporary denies (last 120d), KMS key-wrap/export logs and vendor HSM attestation for CMKs used by inference, vulnerability triage bundle for CVE-2026-1420 tied to IR-2026-077, Opsgenie alert history for that incident, and a signed chain-of-custody manifest (SHA256 per file + HMAC using auditor nonce). Delivery requested by 2026-05-05 EOD. Who owns what?

jess: assigning owners. i'll take RBAC history and the custody manifest. @alex can you run CloudTrail/Splunk exports and Opsgenie alert export? @tara take KMS/HSM artifacts. @sam please assemble vuln triage bundle. legal — can you prep custody statement template?

morgan: quick Q alex — do auditors want both a human-readable CSV timeline and raw CloudTrail JSONs? i usually provide both.

alex: yes, both please. CSV for quick review, raw JSON for forensic. i'll export timeline CSVs and put raw bundles in S3.

	auditor-bot: both preferred. include eventIDs so auditors can cross-verify.

tara: KMS note — two CMKs in scope (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11 and ..:key/bb22). i'll include GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, Encrypt, Decrypt events and key policy revision history. staging to s3://redwood-evidence/kms/fieldwork-20260505/

sam: CVE-2026-1420 triage summary: timeline, root-cause hypothesis, PRs, mitigations, regression test SHAs, and monitoring dashboards. linking to IR-2026-077 and ticket V-4420. i'll keep the summary to one page and include the full artifact bundle.

ajess: alex — please use these Splunk snippets for RBAC timelines:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=CreateRole OR eventName=DeleteRole OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=DetachRolePolicy
| table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters, eventID
| where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-120d@d")
```

alex: copying. i'll also run a CloudTrail export for KMS key-wrap events between 2026-02-01 and 2026-05-01:
```
aws cloudtrail start-export-task --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext --start-time 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-05-01T23:59:59Z --destination-s3-bucket-name redwood-evidence --destination-s3-prefix kms/raw
```

tara: note — HSM vendor attestation (PKCS#7 signed PDF) will be included. one CMK uses vendor-wrapped material; i'll include the vendor thumbprint and import logs. some principal ARNs will be redacted in public artifacts; full mapping goes into HSM-protected bundle for auditors under NDA.

jess: manifest requirements: SHA256 for each object, manifest.json listing file, size, s3_key, and HMAC-SHA256(manifest_json, auditor_nonce) signed with internal key id hk-2024-03. legal, please prepare custody statement template we can sign.

legal: draft custody language: "Redwood Inference attests custody of the attached digital artifacts from collection through delivery. Manifest is HMAC-signed with internal key id=hk-2024-03 and includes auditor-provided nonce. Contact legal@redwood for verification steps."

engsec-bot: verification helper: we'll include a small verify script and instructions: `verify_manifest.sh manifest.json <hmac> <auditor-nonce>` that recomputes SHA256 per object (downloaded) and HMAC. We'll provide steps and sample openssl commands.

ajess: operational checklist & tags: when uploading, include S3 object tags: checksum-sha256 and manifest-id. presign links expire 7 days — use `s3-presign --expires 604800`.

alex: ETA for exports: CSV timelines + raw JSONs to S3 by 2026-05-02 EOD. i'll tag with `manifest-id=sfw-20260505`. will post presigned links in-thread.

tara: ETA for KMS/HSM bundle: 2026-05-01 EOD. will include CloudHSM logs, KMS policy snapshots, vendor attestation PDF, and redaction map.

sam: ETA for vuln triage bundle: 2026-04-30 EOD. will include test run ids and monitoring snapshots.

jess: i'll assemble manifest and sign with HMAC on 2026-05-03 AM, then hand to legal for external delivery approval. pre-review by eng-security on 2026-05-03 PM.

engsec-bot: recommended Splunk query for AssumeRole/passrole correlation: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=AssumeRole OR eventName=PassRole
| stats count by userIdentity.arn,eventName,requestParameters,awsRegion
| where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-120d@d")
```

alex: auditors also requested Opsgenie export for IR-2026-077 (alerts, responders, escalation timeline). i'll export and add to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/IR-2026-077/alerts.json.

tara: remember to include IAM policy simulation per-CMK for service principals using `iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy` so auditors can see who would have had Encrypt/Decrypt permissions at specific dates.

jess: important — mark any artifacts that contain PII or personal emails. redact emails in public CSVs and include a redaction mapping file accessible in the NDA bundle.

alex: noted. i'll add `email_redaction=true` tag to affected objects.

legal: i'll review custody statement once manifest draft is posted. include auditor nonce in manifest file name e.g., manifest-{nonce}.json to avoid confusion.

jess: final deliverables checklist: - RBAC CSV + raw JSON (120d) -> alex - KMS/HSM attestation + key-wrap logs -> tara - Vulnerability triage bundle -> sam - Opsgenie alert history -> alex - Signed manifest + custody statement -> jess/legal - Pre-review by eng-security -> jess on 2026-05-03 PM.

jess: escalate to #eng-security with :rotating_light: if any ETA slips. alex/tara/sam post presigned links here when uploads complete so legal can sign and we can hand off to auditor.

auditor-bot: Acknowledged. Auditor will verify SHA256 checksums and HMAC upon receipt. They may request a live verification call if anything is unclear. Thanks.
